# Hosts

This are some (not all) Hosts that you can access the LaunchDarkly from

- clientstream.launchdarkly.com (streaming, `/meval`)
- clientsdk.launchdarkly.com (polling, `/msdk/evalx`)
- mobile.launchdarkly.com (events, `/mobile`)
- events.launchdarkly.com (only in the shell CSP, no caller found)

<br/>

Mobile keys (one per `-epicenv`, picked from a relative lookup table indexed by the environment):

- prod: `mob-756bbe9a...`
- gamedev: `mob-a3ca5f1c...`
- ci: `mob-a2836a0b...`

<br/>

Recommended Hosts:

- clientstream.launchdarkly.com
